name: MINOR IN HISTORY
title: MINOR IN HISTORY Faculty of Social Science - History

sections.heading: MINOR IN HISTORY
lines: Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 courses in History at the 1000-level, with a mark of at least 60% in each course.

If upper-year students have not completed 1.0 courses in History at the 1000-level, they may make up this admission requirement with 1.0 courses in History at the 2000-level or above (excluding History 2201E or 2205E), with a mark of at least 60% in each course. These qualifying entry course(s) cannot be counted for subsequent program credit.
3.0 of these 4.0 courses must be essay courses.
2.0 courses in History at the 2000-level or above.
1.0 courses in History at the 3000-level or above.
